---
name: Module proposal
about: Propose a new module to add to this repo
title: "[module-proposal] <name>"
labels: module-proposal
---

## Module name & category

E.g. `AtumBridgeModule` under `bridges/`.

## Tier

- [ ] First-party — CC core team will own and audit
- [ ] Community (`contrib/`) — you maintain; CC reviews safety only

## Use case

What problem does this module solve? What flows does it enable on the rail?

## Integration sketch

Which external protocol(s) does it call? On-chain dependencies? Required token approvals?

## Maintenance commitment (contrib only)

Maintainer team handle, security disclosure contact, expected response time for issues.

## Audit status

unaudited / internal-review / audited-by-<firm> / planned
